description: This PHP source file contains a PHPUnit test class for the AuthorizationCodeRepository component within the OAuth module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup for test fixtures, as well as test methods for creating, persisting, revoking, and checking the revocation status of OAuth authorization codes.

classes.name: AuthorizationCodeRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class designed to verify the functionality of the AuthorizationCodeRepository class, including creating, saving, revoking, and checking authorization codes within the OAuth implementation of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by loading fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testGetNewAuthCode
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new authorization code object and verifies initial properties.

methods.name: testPersistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Tests persisting a new authorization code and verifies its stored values.

methods.name: testPersistNewAuthCodeWithExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to persist a duplicate authorization code triggers an exception.

methods.name: testRevokeAuthCode
methods.description: Verifies that an existing authorization code can be revoked and that its state updates accordingly.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Ensures the revoke method handles non-existent codes gracefully without errors.

methods.name: testIsAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether the system correctly reports revocation status for existing codes.

methods.name: testIsAuthCodeRevokedForNonExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Verifies that non-existent authorization codes are reported as revoked.
